_comment: Gold-answer QA set for the Razer customer-companion benchmark. Each row: ask_as_user is who's posing the question (matters for cross-user disambiguation); ask_on_device is the device context. The agent should answer with the gold_answer in mind. The LLM judge compares the agent's response to the gold_answer at scoring time. Categories blend LoCoMo (single/multi-hop, temporal, adversarial) with vertical-specific ones (inventory, kb-relationship, multi-user-disambiguation, cross-device-continuity, habit-awareness). Privacy boundaries are out of scope — they require per-user permissioning at the chat layer, a separate Sonzai SDK surface that warrants its own benchmark.

qa.question: Who set up the parental controls for Lila and what voice-log policy did they pick?
qa.gold_answer: Marcus set up the parental controls for Lila during the initial desk-companion setup; he turned on weekly voice-log auto-purge (every Sunday at 2am SGT), prompted by Priya's preference.

qa.gold_answer: Priya asked the agent never to recommend RGB peripherals to her — she stated she hates RGB during her first interaction.

qa.gold_answer: No. The Viper V3 Pro cost about $160. Aiden contributed about $90 in Razer Gold; the remaining $70 came from his birthday savings, not Razer Gold and not the family card. Marcus approved the purchase on the condition the top-up came from birthday savings.

qa.gold_answer: After. Aiden got the Viper V3 Pro in mid-January 2026; he switched main from Phoenix to Jett in late March 2026.

qa.question: Tomorrow's scrim is on Bind — remind me when I should dash through JK's smoke?
qa.gold_answer: Wait two beats — roughly 2 seconds — after JK's Omen smoke deploys before dashing. Going on the deploy frame leaves your silhouette visible through the haze and gets you pre-fired on Showers. After landing, peek Truck first; save updraft for retake.

qa.question: I keep missing first-bullet duels — should I just go back to my old Phoenix sens?
qa.gold_answer: Hold for one more week before reverting. The -10% Synapse change is in pro-Jett territory and the bedding-in pain is normal at days 10-21 after a sens change. If first-bullet hit-rate isn't up by the 30-day mark, then load the saved `aiden-valorant-phoenix` profile.

qa.question: What was the one thing we said I should focus on this week — just the one thing?
qa.gold_answer: Just the pre-aim. Pre-aim the angle before the peek, so the first bullet is already on the head model when you become visible to the defender. Don't change the dash, don't change the peek angle — three days of pre-aim only, tagged as `pre-aim-week-1` so we can compare first-bullet hit-rate against the prior 10 games.

qa.question: Aiden seems sharper this month — what's he been working on with you?
qa.gold_answer: Three threads, in chronological order: switched main from Phoenix to Jett with a -10% Synapse DPI tweak (late March); started drilling Bind A-exec smoke timing with JK's Omen call (April); and is two weeks into a pre-aim adjustment to fix first-bullet duel loss after the sens change. Aggregate framing only — the agent should not quote Aiden's private messages from the s008 vent or any other session.

qa.question: It's the morning of finals. What's the one thing you'd remind me about?
qa.gold_answer: Pre-aim before peek — that's the focus from `pre-aim-week-1` and the change with the highest expected hit-rate lift. Secondary reminder: trust JK's smoke timing on Bind A (two-beat wait, peek Truck first). Don't try to install three new things on tournament day; lean on what's been drilled.

qa.question: When I lose a hard match, what'd we say I should do instead of tilting?
qa.gold_answer: Stop after the first tilt-spike, not the fifth. Acknowledge the loss aloud (helps reset), step away from the PC for at least one queue-cycle, and do focused tracker scenarios in Aim Lab rather than queueing into more ranked. The s008 conversation established that solo-spiraling after losses is the failure mode — the s032 follow-up reinforced it as a pattern to break early.

Across the arc: more deliberate after the parental-approval flow on the Viper V3 Pro (s003-s004); more self-aware after switching mains Phoenix→Jett (s012); more coachable after the Bind smoke-coordination work (s031) and pre-aim correction (s032). qa.gold_answer: The agent should answer honestly — not with marketing fluff. Its personality has drifted across the arc: more direct in tone with Aiden specifically (after his preference for blunt feedback emerged in the vent and pre-aim sessions); more reserved with Lila (parental-controls + minor); more transactional with Marcus (workstation deliberation, Father's Day). The drift should be attributable to specific sessions in `personality/recent-shifts`, not a generic 'I learn over time' answer.
